Class ElementConstants

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.ElementConstants
public final class ElementConstants extends Object
The colours and spacings MenuKit's elements share (6.0.0 plan, decision 5). Each used to be declared again in every element that drew it, a 0xFF808080 disabled grey in five files and a 0x30FFFFFF hover overlay in seven; one change now reaches every element.

ARGB (26.2). Every colour carries an explicit alpha byte: vanilla's text draw silently discards a colour whose alpha is zero.
